_doc: Battery Ventures' cross-investor rulings for COLLECTION.md invariant 10 (run.py verify), scoped to this investor and merged at read time with data/collection/cross-investor.json. Written during the PRO-97 S2A pass, 2026-09-17; the shared file is touched only at wave alignment. `distinct` = the loose name key matched two different companies; `accepted` = the same company with a real, explained disagreement; `same` = confirmed identity. Six of the eight disagreements this pass raised were the same company and were fixed by aligning the stale side with a citation (chai-discovery, function-health and unify on Battery's side; kustomer, gogobot and motherduck on Redpoint's), which is invariant 10 working as intended.

distinct.note: different companies: Battery's 'Guild Technologies' is a compliance-list-only, exited and unresolved name, while Redpoint's 'Guild' is Guild Education, the private Denver education-benefits company whose June 2022 Series F priced it at $4.4B - Battery's own classification note already says the row is not the Denver company.

different companies: Battery's 'Northstar Technology, Inc.' is a compliance-list-only name marked exited and unrecognized, while Benchmark's 'Northstar' is a pre-window row from its 2004-2008 captures that Benchmark itself records as not resolving to any specific operating entity; only the loose name key joins them.
